League Rule Notes
All fouls must be called by players at the table; without an interference (foul) from others.
Players are encouraged to know the rules; especially pertaining to Push Shots.
Any scratch (including on the break) is a foul.
If an object ball is accidently moved (don't automatically return it), the opposing player has the option of leaving it where it is or returning it to its previous spot.
Accidentally moving the cue ball is a foul.
Accidentally moving any ball during a massé or jump shot attempt is a foul.
Accidentally moving one object ball is not a foul and the opponent has the option to restore the ball to its original position.
Accidentally moving more than one ball is a foul without a restore option.
IF A PLAYER DOUBLE PLAYS, THE SECOND ENTRY FOR THAT PLAYER MUST GO UP ONE HANDICAP POINT.
All fouls are ball in hand anywhere on the table.
Object balls knocked off the table are dead (dropped) and the shot is a foul.
Table is open after the break.
ALL PLAYERS GET 1 (60-SEC) TIME OUT PER GAME  ·  4'S & UNDER GET 2 (30-SEC) TIME OUTS PER GAME  ·  PLAYER MUST CALL TIME OUT  ·  TEAM KEEPS TIME
